mapper.sql: id, workspace_id, scheduled_task_id, trigger_key, trigger_type, scheduled_at, started_at, finished_at, status, skip_reason, squad_id, initial_agent_id, current_agent_id, sdlc_id, current_step_id, session_mode, resume_from_run_id, degraded_resume, degraded_reason, execution_snapshot_json, result_summary, error, owner_id, gmt_create, gmt_modified, creator_id, modifier_id, version
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scheduled_task_run (workspace_id, scheduled_task_id, trigger_key, trigger_type, scheduled_at, started_at, finished_at, status, skip_reason, squad_id, initial_agent_id, current_agent_id, sdlc_id, current_step_id, session_mode, resume_from_run_id, degraded_resume, degraded_reason, execution_snapshot_json, result_summary, error, owner_id, creator_id, modifier_id, version) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{scheduledTaskId}, #{triggerKey}, #{triggerType}, #{scheduledAt}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{status}, #{skipReason}, #{squadId}, #{initialAgentId}, #{currentAgentId}, #{sdlcId}, #{currentStepId}, #{sessionMode}, #{resumeFromRunId}, 0, #{degradedReason}, #{executionSnapshotJson}, #{resultSummary}, #{error}, #{ownerId}, #{creatorId}, #{modifierId}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM scheduled_task_run WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id}

SELECT FROM scheduled_task_run WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND scheduled_task_id = #{scheduledTaskId} AND status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'TIMED_OUT', 'CANCELED', 'SKIPPED') ORDER BY scheduled_at ASC, id ASC

SELECT FROM scheduled_task_run WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND scheduled_task_id = #{scheduledTaskId} AND status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'TIMED_OUT', 'CANCELED', 'SKIPPED') ORDER BY scheduled_at ASC, id ASC FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scheduled_task_run WHERE status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'TIMED_OUT', 'CANCELED', 'SKIPPED')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scheduled_task_run WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND scheduled_task_id = #{scheduledTaskId} AND finished_at >= #{since} AND status IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','TIMED_OUT','CANCELED','SKIPPED')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scheduled_task_run WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND scheduled_task_id = #{scheduledTaskId} AND finished_at >= #{since} AND status = 'SUCCEEDED'
SELECT FROM scheduled_task_run WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND scheduled_task_id = #{scheduledTaskId} AND status = 'QUEUED' ORDER BY scheduled_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE scheduled_task_run SET status = #{targetStatus}, started_at = CASE WHEN #{targetStatus} = 'STARTING' THEN COALESCE(started_at, NOW(3)) ELSE started_at END, modifier_id = #{modifierId}, version = version + 1 WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND status = #{expectedStatus} AND status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'TIMED_OUT', 'CANCELED', 'SKIPPED') AND #{targetStatus} IN ('QUEUED', 'STARTING', 'WAITING_EXECUTOR', 'RUNNING', 'WAITING_HUMAN', 'PAUSED') AND version = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE scheduled_task_run SET sdlc_id = #{sdlcId}, current_agent_id = #{currentAgentId}, current_step_id = #{currentStepId}, modifier_id = #{modifierId}, version = version + 1 WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'TIMED_OUT', 'CANCELED', 'SKIPPED')

UPDATE scheduled_task_run SET status = 'STARTING', started_at = COALESCE(started_at, NOW(3)), sdlc_id = #{sdlcId}, current_agent_id = #{currentAgentId}, current_step_id = #{currentStepId}, modifier_id = #{modifierId}, version = version + 1 WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND status = #{expectedStatus} AND #{expectedStatus} IN ('QUEUED', 'STARTING') AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'TIMED_OUT', 'CANCELED', 'SKIPPED')

UPDATE scheduled_task_run SET status = #{targetStatus}, result_summary = #{resultSummary}, error = #{error}, finished_at = COALESCE(finished_at, NOW(3)), modifier_id = #{modifierId}, version = version + 1 WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND status = #{expectedStatus} AND status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'TIMED_OUT', 'CANCELED', 'SKIPPED') AND #{targetStatus} IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'TIMED_OUT', 'CANCELED', 'SKIPPED') AND version = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE scheduled_task_run SET degraded_resume = 1, degraded_reason = #{degradedReason}, resume_from_run_id = #{resumeFromRunId}, modifier_id = #{modifierId}, version = version + 1 WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'TIMED_OUT', 'CANCELED', 'SKIPPED')

UPDATE scheduled_task_run SET resume_from_run_id = #{resumeFromRunId}, modifier_id = #{modifierId}, version = version + 1 WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'TIMED_OUT', 'CANCELED', 'SKIPPED')

UPDATE scheduled_task_run SET error = 'CANCEL_PENDING', modifier_id = #{modifierId}, version = version + 1 WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'PAUSED' AND version = #{expectedVersion}
